words.en: Spend or allocate more money on something.

words.w: introduce tax incentives to encourage investment
words.tr: phrase. 通过引入税收激励措施来鼓励投资
words.uk: ˌɪntrəˈdjuːs tæks ˈɪnsentɪvz tə ɪnˈkʌrɪdʒ ɪnˈvestmənt
words.us: ˌɪntrəˈdus tæks ˈɪnsentɪvz tə ɪnˈkɜːrɪdʒ ɪnˈvestmənt
words.ex: The government introduces tax incentives to encourage investment.
words.ex_cn: 政府推出税收优惠以鼓励投资。
words.en: To offer tax benefits to stimulate investment in an economy.

words.tr: v. 吸引外国资本投资
words.ex: The government wants to attract foreign capital investment.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望吸引外国资本投资。
words.en: to draw financial resources from other countries into one's own economy.

words.tr: phrase. 长期投资；指持有期限较长、以实现资本增值或稳定收益为目的的投资
words.ex: He made a long-term investment in real estate.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了房地产的长期投资。
words.en: An investment that is expected to yield returns over a long period of time, typically several years or more.

words.tr: phrase. 尊重个人选择
words.ex: He respects personal choice in clothing.
words.ex_cn: 他尊重个人在穿着上的选择。
words.en: To acknowledge and honor the decisions made by individuals regarding their own lives.

words.w: buildpromote a free and fair society
words.tr: v. 建设并促进一个自由与公平的社会
words.uk: /bɪld prəˈməʊt ə friː ənd feə ˈsəʊsaɪəti/
words.us: /bɪld prəˈmoʊt ə fri ənd fer ˈsoʊsaɪəti/
words.ex: Governments should build and promote a free and fair society.
words.ex_cn: 政府应该建设并促进一个自由与公平的社会。
words.en: To develop and encourage a society based on freedom, justice, and impartiality.

words.tr: phrase. 免受政府干预的；不受政府干涉的
words.ex: The market should be free from government intervention.
words.ex_cn: 市场应该不受政府干预。
words.en: To be free from government intervention means to operate or exist without any interference or control from the government.

words.tr: phrase. 感到被尊重和被重视
words.ex: She feels respected and valued at her new job.
words.ex_cn: 她在新工作中感到被尊重和重视。
words.en: To experience a sense of being esteemed and appreciated.

words.tr: phrase. 侵犯他人隐私
words.ex: The app tries to invade people's privacy by collecting their messages.
words.ex_cn: 这款应用通过收集用户的短信来侵犯他们的隐私。
words.en: To intrude upon or violate someone's personal space, information, or private life without consent.

words.tr: phrase. 侵犯个人自由
words.ex: The law cannot infringe personal freedom.
words.ex_cn: 法律不能侵犯个人自由。
words.en: To violate or restrict someone's personal liberty or rights.

words.tr: adj. 难以监管和监督的
words.uk: hɑːd ˈdɪfɪkəlt tə ˈreɡjuleɪt ənd ˌəʊvəˈsiː
words.us: hɑːrd ˈdɪfɪkəlt tə ˈreɡjəleɪt ənd ˌoʊvərˈsiː
words.ex: The black market is hard to regulate and oversee.
words.ex_cn: 黑市难以监管和监督。
words.en: Challenging to control or supervise effectively due to complexity or lack of clear rules.

words.tr: phrase. 不切实际；不实用
words.ex: It is impractical to walk 50 miles every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天走50英里是不切实际的。
words.en: If something is impractical, it is not sensible or realistic, and it would not work well in practice.

words.tr: phrase. 目光短浅的政策
words.ex: The government made a short-sighted policy to cut education funding.
words.ex_cn: 政府制定了一项短视的政策，削减了教育经费。
words.en: A policy that lacks foresight or long-term planning.

words.tr: v. 促进一种平等、尊严与自豪感
words.uk: prəˈməʊt ə sens ɒv ˈiːkwəli, ˈdɪɡnəti, praɪd
words.us: prəˈmoʊt ə sens əv ˈiːkwəli, ˈdɪɡnəti, praɪd
words.ex: The program helps promote a sense of equality, dignity, and pride among students.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有助于促进学生对平等、尊严与自豪感的认同。
words.en: To encourage feelings of fairness, self-worth, and pride in individuals or groups.

words.tr: phrase. 推广健康的生活方式；倡导健康生活
words.ex: The school promotes a healthy lifestyle by offering fresh fruits and daily sports.
words.ex_cn: 学校通过提供新鲜水果和每日运动来促进健康的生活方式。
words.en: To encourage or support the adoption of habits and behaviors that contribute to physical and mental well-being.

words.w: increase enhance ameliorate elevate the quality of people's life
words.tr: v. 提高、增强、改善、提升人们的生活质量
words.uk: ɪnˈkriːs ɪnˈhɑːns əˈmiːliəreɪt ˈelɪveɪt ðə ˈkwɒləti əv ˈpiːplz laɪf
words.us: ɪnˈkris ɛnˈhæns əˈmilɪəˌret ˈɛləˌvet ðə ˈkwɑləti əv ˈpipəlz laɪf
words.ex: The new policy aims to increase the quality of people's life.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策旨在提高人们的生活质量。
words.en: Improve or raise the standard of living for individuals or communities.

words.tr: phrase. 提高人们对……的意识；增强公众对……的认知
words.ex: The poster helps to raise people's awareness of clean water.
words.ex_cn: 这幅海报有助于提高人们对清洁用水的意识。
words.en: To increase the understanding or knowledge of people about a particular issue or subject.

words.tr: phrase. 倾听公众的意见
words.ex: The mayor listens to the public's opinions.
words.ex_cn: 市长听取公众的意见。
words.en: To pay attention to and consider the views and feedback expressed by the general population.

words.tr: phrase. 高收入群体；指收入水平较高的个人或家庭组成的群体
words.ex: The high income group pays more taxes.
words.ex_cn: 高收入群体缴纳更多的税。
words.en: A group of people who earn a significantly higher amount of money compared to the average income level.

words.tr: phrase. 人们对生活的满意度
words.ex: People's satisfaction with life has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年人们对生活的满意度提高了。
words.en: The degree to which individuals feel content and fulfilled with their overall existence and circumstances.

words.tr: phrase. 维持法律与秩序；维护治安
words.ex: The police work hard to maintain law and order in the city.
words.ex_cn: 警察努力在城市中维持法律与秩序。
words.en: To maintain law and order means to ensure that laws are obeyed and that there is peace and stability in a society.

words.tr: phrase. 生活在恶劣的环境中；处于贫困状态
words.ex: They live in a poor condition with no clean water.
words.ex_cn: 他们生活在恶劣的条件下，没有干净的水。
words.en: To exist in a state of poverty or deprivation.

words.tr: phrase. 对吸烟施加限制；对吸烟实行管制
words.ex: The government will impose restrictions on smoking in public places.
words.ex_cn: 政府将对在公共场所吸烟施加限制。
words.en: To enforce rules or limitations on the act of smoking, typically to reduce its prevalence or impact on public health.

words.tr: phrase. 投入资源于……；把资源用于……
words.ex: They put resources into building a new school.
words.ex_cn: 他们投入资源建设一所新学校。
words.en: To allocate or invest resources such as time, money, or effort into a particular activity or project.

words.tr: phrase. 推出税收激励措施；引入税收优惠政策
words.ex: The government will introduce tax incentives for green energy.
words.ex_cn: 政府将为绿色能源引入税收优惠。
words.en: To introduce tax incentives means to implement policies that offer financial benefits or reductions in taxes to encourage certain behaviors or investments.

words.w: do something by persuasion rather than compulsion
words.tr: 通过说服而非强迫来做某事
words.uk: duː ˈsʌmθɪŋ baɪ pəˈsweɪʒn ˈrɑːðə ðæn kəmˈpʌlʃn
words.us: du ˈsʌmθɪŋ baɪ pərˈsweɪʒn ˈræðər ðæn kəmˈpʌlʃn
words.ex: He got his brother to clean the room by persuasion rather than compulsion.
words.ex_cn: 他通过说服而不是强迫让弟弟打扫了房间。
words.en: To achieve an outcome through influence and argument, not force.

words.tr: phrase. 政府资助的项目；政府赞助的计划
words.ex: The government-sponsored program gives free books to students.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助的项目为学生提供免费书籍。
words.en: A program that is financially supported by the government to achieve specific public goals.

words.tr: phrase. 为了…的利益；出于对…的考虑
words.ex: He stayed late in the interest of finishing the project.
words.ex_cn: 为了完成项目，他待到了很晚。
words.en: For the benefit or advantage of someone or something; in order to achieve or maintain something.

words.w: be in line with the general interests
words.tr: phrase. 符合总体利益；与普遍利益一致
words.uk: biː ɪn laɪn wɪð ðə ˈdʒenrəl ˈɪntrəsts
words.us: bi ɪn laɪn wɪð ðə ˈdʒɛnərəl ˈɪntrəsts
words.ex: The policy must be in line with the general interests of the people.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策必须符合人民的总体利益。
words.en: To be in line with the general interests means to be consistent with or supportive of the overall welfare or benefit of a group or community.

words.tr: phrase. 保护小型企业
words.ex: The government helps to protect small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府帮助保护小企业。
words.en: To protect small businesses means to take measures to safeguard them from harm, competition, or economic challenges, ensuring their survival and growth.

words.w: to provide humanitarian aid to the war zone
words.tr: phrase. 向战区提供人道主义援助
words.uk: tə prəˈvaɪd ˌhjuːmənɪˈteəriən eɪd tə ðə wɔː zəʊn
words.us: tə prəˈvaɪd ˌhjuːmənɪˈteriən eɪd tə ðə wɔːr zoʊn
words.ex: The group plans to provide humanitarian aid to the war zone.
words.ex_cn: 该组织计划向战区提供人道主义援助。
words.en: To give help and support to people in a war-affected area.

words.tr: phrase. 出于人道主义原因
words.ex: They opened the border for humanitarian reasons.
words.ex_cn: 他们出于人道主义原因开放了边境。
words.en: For reasons connected with helping people in need or suffering.

words.tr: phrase. 捐赠国；提供援助的国家
words.ex: The donating countries sent food to the poor region.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠国向贫困地区运送了食物。
words.en: Nations that give money, goods, or resources to help others.

words.tr: phrase. 贫困的国家；经济极度落后的国家
words.ex: Impoverished countries need more help from rich nations.
words.ex_cn: 贫困国家需要富裕国家更多的帮助。
words.en: Nations with very low levels of economic development and high poverty rates.

words.tr: phrase. 欠发达国家；发展中国家（指经济、工业或社会基础设施发展水平较低的国家）
words.ex: Many underdeveloped countries need more schools and hospitals.
words.ex_cn: 许多欠发达国家需要更多的学校和医院。
words.en: Countries that have a lower standard of living, less industrial development, and lower Human Development Index (HDI) compared to other countries.

words.tr: v. 提供援助；提供帮助（尤指医疗、经济或技术支持）
words.ex: The school provides aids to students with disabilities.
words.ex_cn: 学校为残疾学生提供帮助。
words.en: To give assistance, especially financial or material support, to those in need.

words.tr: phrase. 国际援助；对外援助
words.ex: The country received international aid after the earthquake.
words.ex_cn: 地震后，这个国家收到了国际援助。
words.en: Assistance provided by one country or an international organization to another, typically in the form of money, goods, or services, to support development, emergency relief, or welfare.

words.tr: phrase. 国际社会；国际共同体
words.ex: The international community supports peace in the region.
words.ex_cn: 国际社会支持该地区的和平。
words.en: The term 'the international community' refers to the broad, global community of nations and peoples, often represented by governments, international organizations, and NGOs, working together on issues of mutual concern.

words.tr: phrase. 外国援助；国际援助
words.ex: The country receives foreign aid to help its poor people.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家接受外国援助来帮助它的穷人。
words.en: Financial or material assistance given by one country to another, typically to support economic development or to respond to a crisis.

words.tr: phrase. 医疗援助；医疗救助
words.ex: He received medical aid after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后得到了医疗援助。
words.en: Medical aid refers to the provision of health care services, including the supply of medicines, medical equipment, and the services of health care professionals, to individuals or communities in need, often in response to emergencies or in underprivileged areas.

words.tr: phrase. 受援国；接受援助的国家
words.ex: The rich nations give money to recipient countries.
words.ex_cn: 富裕国家向受援国提供资金。
words.en: Nations that receive aid, investment, or support from external sources, often in the context of development or relief.

words.tr: phrase. 消除贫困；根除贫穷
words.ex: The government wants to eliminate poverty.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望消除贫困。
words.en: To eliminate poverty means to completely remove or get rid of poverty, ensuring that people have the necessary resources and opportunities to live a decent life.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻痛苦；缓解苦难
words.ex: The medicine helps to ease the sufferings of patients.
words.ex_cn: 这种药物有助于减轻病人的痛苦。
words.en: To alleviate or reduce the pain or distress experienced by someone.

words.tr: phrase. 不平等的社会
words.ex: The unequal society makes life hard for poor people.
words.ex_cn: 不平等的社会让穷人生活艰难。
words.en: A society where wealth, power, or opportunities are not shared fairly.

words.tr: phrase. 安全的饮用水；符合卫生标准的水
words.ex: They drink safe water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他们喝来自水井的安全水。
words.en: Water that is free from harmful microorganisms and chemical contaminants, making it suitable for drinking and daily use.

words.tr: phrase. 基础教育
words.ex: He received basic education in a small village school.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个小村庄的学校接受了基础教育。
words.en: Basic education refers to the initial stage of formal education, typically including primary and secondary education, aimed at providing fundamental knowledge and skills.

words.tr: phrase. 疫苗接种计划；疫苗项目
words.ex: The government launched a vaccine programme to protect children.
words.ex_cn: 政府启动了一项疫苗计划来保护儿童。
words.en: An organized plan to distribute and administer vaccines to a population, often to prevent disease outbreaks.

words.tr: phrase. 基本医疗保健；基础卫生服务
words.ex: The village has basic health care for all children.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄为所有儿童提供基本医疗保健。
words.en: Essential medical services and support to maintain or improve physical and mental well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 基础设施发展；基础设施建设
words.ex: The government is funding infrastructural development in rural areas.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在为农村地区的基础设施建设提供资金。
words.en: The process of improving and expanding the basic physical and organizational structures and facilities needed for the operation of a society or enterprise.

words.tr: phrase. 应对紧急需求；处理迫切需要
words.ex: The doctor must address urgent needs right away.
words.ex_cn: 医生必须立即处理紧急需求。
words.en: To deal with or take action on pressing or immediate requirements.

words.w: bridge the gap between the rich and poor
words.tr: 短语动词. 缩小贫富之间的差距
words.uk: brɪdʒ ðə ɡæp bɪˈtwiːn ðə rɪtʃ ənd pʊə(r)
words.us: brɪdʒ ðə ɡæp bɪˈtwin ðə rɪtʃ ənd pʊr
words.ex: The program helps to bridge the gap between the rich and poor.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目帮助缩小富人和穷人之间的差距。
words.en: To reduce the differences in wealth and opportunities between the rich and the poor.

words.tr: phrase. 寻求共同发展
words.ex: Countries seek common development through cooperation.
words.ex_cn: 各国通过合作寻求共同发展。
words.en: To strive for mutual progress and growth in a collaborative manner.

words.tr: phrase. 履行道德义务
words.ex: He fulfils moral obligations by helping the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他通过帮助穷人履行道德义务。
words.en: To satisfy or carry out duties and responsibilities based on ethical principles and conscience.

words.tr: phrase. 提供帮助；给予援助
words.ex: He will give assistance to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他会帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To provide help, support, or aid to someone in need.

words.tr: phrase. 腐败的政府官员；指滥用职权、贪污受贿或为私利而违背职责的政府工作人员
words.ex: The police arrested some corrupt government officials.
words.ex_cn: 警察逮捕了一些腐败的政府官员。
words.en: Public officials who engage in dishonest or illegal activities.

words.tr: phrase. 政治腐败；指公职人员滥用职权以谋取私利的行为
words.ex: The government fought against political corruption.
words.ex_cn: 政府打击政治腐败。
words.en: The misuse of public office for private gain, involving bribery, embezzlement, or abuse of power.

words.tr: phrase. 非政府组织
words.ex: The non-governmental organisation helps poor children.
words.ex_cn: 这个非政府组织帮助贫困儿童。
words.en: An organization that operates independently of government, typically focusing on social, humanitarian, or environmental issues.

words.tr: phrase. 政治自由；指个人或群体参与政治活动、表达政治观点及选择政府的权利
words.ex: He wants political freedom in his country.
words.ex_cn: 他希望自己的国家拥有政治自由。
words.en: Political freedom refers to the right of individuals to participate in the political process, express their opinions, and choose their leaders without undue interference.

words.tr: phrase. 负债累累的；深陷债务的
words.ex: He is heavily in debt after buying a new car.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一辆新车后欠了很多债。
words.en: Owing a very large amount of money to others.

words.tr: phrase. 一种慷慨的行为
words.ex: He gave money to the homeless man, an act of generosity.
words.ex_cn: 他给了那个无家可归的人钱，这是一种慷慨的行为。
words.en: An act of giving freely, often involving kindness, charity, or selflessness.

words.tr: phrase. 一种团结一致的姿态；表示支持与团结的举动
words.ex: He gave a gesture of solidarity by standing with the workers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过与工人站在一起表达了团结。
words.en: An action or expression intended to show support, unity, or sympathy with others.

words.tr: phrase. 混合影响；正负兼具的影响
words.ex: The new policy has mixed impacts on the environment.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策对环境有好坏混合的影响。
words.en: Both positive and negative effects or results.

words.tr: phrase. 减少对援助的依赖
words.ex: The country wants to reduce aid dependency by growing its own farms.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望通过发展自己的农业来减少对援助的依赖。
words.en: To lessen reliance on external financial or material assistance, promoting self-sufficiency.

words.tr: phrase. 身份危机；自我认同危机（指个人对自我角色或价值产生困惑与焦虑的心理状态）
words.ex: He is having an identity crisis after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后陷入了身份危机。
words.en: A period of uncertainty and self-doubt about one's personal identity, values, or purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 地球村（指因通信和交通发展使世界变得紧密相连，如同一个村庄）
words.ex: The internet makes the world a global village.
words.ex_cn: 互联网让世界成为一个地球村。
words.en: The term 'global village' refers to the idea that the world has become more interconnected due to the rapid advancement of communication and transportation technologies, making distances between people seem shorter.

words.tr: phrase. 文化交流；跨文化沟通
words.ex: They practice cultural communication to understand different traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过文化沟通来理解不同的传统。
words.en: The exchange of ideas, values, and information between different cultures.

words.tr: phrase. 商业贸易；商务交易
words.ex: They do business trade with nearby countries.
words.ex_cn: 他们与邻近国家进行商业贸易。
words.en: The exchange of goods and services between nations or companies across international borders.

words.tr: phrase. 合作；共同努力；协同工作
words.ex: They work together to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他们一起努力完成这个项目。
words.en: To collaborate or cooperate with others in order to achieve a common goal.

words.w: for the betterment of the world
words.tr: 为了世界的改善；为了使世界变得更好
words.uk: fɔː ðə ˈbetəmənt ɒv ðə wɜːld
words.us: fɔːr ðə ˈbetərmənt ʌv ðə wɜːrld
words.ex: He works hard for the betterment of the world.
words.ex_cn: 他努力为世界的进步而工作。
words.en: For the purpose of improving the condition of the planet and its inhabitants.

words.w: a wide range of global problems
words.tr: 短语。各种各样的全球性问题
words.uk: ə waɪd reɪndʒ əv ˈɡləʊbəl ˈprɒbləmz
words.us: ə waɪd reɪndʒ əv ˈɡloʊbəl ˈprɑːbləmz
words.ex: Governments must solve a wide range of global problems.
words.ex_cn: 政府必须解决一系列全球性问题。
words.en: A broad variety of challenges affecting the entire world population.

words.tr: phrase. 由人类引起的问题；人类造成的议题
words.ex: Pollution and deforestation are issues caused by humanity.
words.ex_cn: 污染和砍伐森林是由人类引起的问题。
words.en: Problems originating from or created by human actions and decisions.

words.w: a difficult place to live in
words.tr: 一个难以居住的地方
words.uk: ə ˈdɪfɪkəlt pleɪs tə lɪv ɪn
words.us: ə ˈdɪfɪkəlt pleɪs tə lɪv ɪn
words.ex: This town is a difficult place to live in.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇是一个难以居住的地方。
words.en: A place that is hard or unpleasant to live in.

words.tr: phrase. 全球性问题；具有全球规模的问题
words.ex: These problems of global scale need all countries to work together.
words.ex_cn: 这些全球性的问题需要所有国家共同努力。
words.en: Issues that affect the whole world.

words.tr: phrase. 国家的生存；民族的存续
words.ex: The survival of nations depends on peace and cooperation.
words.ex_cn: 国家的生存依赖于和平与合作。
words.en: The continued existence of countries as independent entities.

words.tr: phrase. 全球范围的环境恶化
words.ex: Worldwide environmental degradation is getting worse every year.
words.ex_cn: 全球环境退化每年都在恶化。
words.en: The widespread deterioration of the natural environment due to human activities like pollution and deforestation.

words.tr: phrase. 全球变暖
words.ex: Global warming is making the Earth hotter.
words.ex_cn: 全球变暖正在让地球变得更热。
words.en: Global warming refers to the long-term increase in Earth's average surface temperature due to human activities, primarily fossil fuel burning, which increases heat-trapping greenhouse gas levels in Earth's atmosphere.

words.tr: phrase. 全球范围内的生物多样性丧失
words.ex: There is a worldwide loss of biodiversity because of pollution and deforestation.
words.ex_cn: 由于污染和森林砍伐，全球生物多样性正在丧失。
words.en: The rapid decline in the variety of plant and animal species across the globe, threatening ecosystems.

words.tr: n. 淡水危机：指全球或地区范围内可利用淡水资源严重短缺所引发的紧急状况
words.ex: The village faces a freshwater crisis because of the dry season.
words.ex_cn: 由于旱季，这个村庄面临淡水危机。
words.en: A critical shortage of usable freshwater resources, often caused by pollution, overuse, and climate change.

words.tr: phrase. 能源危机；指由于能源供应不足或价格上涨导致的严重能源短缺情况
words.ex: The country faces an energy crisis because of too little oil.
words.ex_cn: 由于石油太少，这个国家面临能源危机。
words.en: A situation in which the demand for energy resources exceeds the available supply, leading to a shortage and potentially causing economic and social problems.

words.tr: n. 大规模自然灾害
words.ex: Large-scale natural disasters destroy homes and roads.
words.ex_cn: 大规模自然灾害摧毁了房屋和道路。
words.en: Major natural catastrophes affecting vast areas.

words.tr: n. 全球经济放缓；指全球范围内经济增长速度减缓的现象
words.ex: The global economic slowdown caused many companies to lay off workers.
words.ex_cn: 全球经济放缓导致许多公司裁员。
words.en: A period of reduced economic growth or contraction that affects countries and markets worldwide.

words.tr: n. 不稳定的经济结构
words.ex: The country has a volatile economic structure.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济结构不稳定。
words.en: An unstable economic system prone to sudden changes.

words.tr: n. 非法毒品的国际贸易
words.ex: The government is fighting international trade in illegal drugs.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在打击非法毒品的国际贸易。
words.en: The buying and selling of banned drugs across national borders.

words.w: poaching and illegal trade in endangered species
words.tr: n. 偷猎和濒危物种的非法贸易

words.us: ˈpoʊtʃɪŋ ənd ɪˈliːɡl treɪd ɪn ɪnˈdeɪndʒərd ˈspiːʃiːz
words.ex: Poaching and illegal trade in endangered species hurt nature badly.
words.ex_cn: 偷猎和非法交易濒危物种严重破坏了自然。
words.en: The illegal hunting of wildlife and commerce in threatened animals.

words.tr: phrase. 艾滋病流行；艾滋病疫情
words.ex: The aids epidemic affected many countries in the 1990s.
words.ex_cn: 艾滋病流行在20世纪90年代影响了许多国家。
words.en: An outbreak of AIDS (Acquired Immune Deficiency Syndrome) that spreads rapidly and affects many individuals in a population at the same time.

words.tr: n. 全球化的不可逆过程
words.ex: The irreversible process of globalisation changes how countries trade and talk.
words.ex_cn: 全球化的不可逆过程改变了各国贸易和交流的方式。
words.en: The irreversible process of globalisation: The unstoppable worldwide integration of economies, cultures, and populations.

words.tr: adj. 日益相互关联的；越来越紧密相连的
words.ex: Cities are increasingly interconnected through the internet.
words.ex_cn: 城市通过互联网越来越相互连接。
words.en: Becoming more closely linked and dependent on each other.

words.tr: v. 促进和平与善意
words.ex: The school promotes peace and goodwill among students.
words.ex_cn: 学校在学生之间促进和平与友好。
words.en: To encourage harmony and kind intentions among people.

words.tr: v. 建立并维持积极的人际关系
words.ex: He works hard to build and maintain positive relationships with his coworkers.
words.ex_cn: 他努力与同事建立并保持良好的关系。
words.en: Build and maintain positive relationships: To establish and sustain beneficial connections with others.

words.tr: n. 建设性伙伴关系
words.ex: They built a constructive partnership to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他们建立了建设性的合作关系来解决问题。
words.en: A collaborative relationship that yields positive, beneficial results.

words.tr: phrase. 促进相互理解；增进彼此了解
words.ex: We eat together to promote mutual understanding.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起吃饭以促进相互理解。
words.en: To encourage and foster mutual understanding and goodwill between people or groups.

words.tr: n. 尊重与信任
words.ex: He earns respect and trust by being honest.
words.ex_cn: 他通过诚实赢得尊重和信任。
words.en: A feeling of deep admiration and confidence in someone or something.

words.tr: 对抗环境的；与环境问题作斗争的
words.ex: The government plans to combat environmental pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府计划对抗环境污染。
words.en: To fight against or take action to address environmental degradation and climate change.

words.tr: adj. 经济（上）的；
words.ex: The economic situation is getting worse.
words.ex_cn: 经济状况正在恶化。
words.en: Economic means concerned with the organization of the money, industry, and trade of a country, region, or society.

words.tr: n. 犯罪与健康问题
words.ex: Drinking too much can cause criminal and health problems.
words.ex_cn: 喝太多酒会导致犯罪和健康问题。
words.en: Problems related to illegal activities and public health issues, often interconnected.

words.tr: n. 各国之间的合作努力
words.ex: Countries made cooperative efforts among countries to fight climate change.
words.ex_cn: 各国共同努力应对气候变化。
words.en: Collaborative actions undertaken by multiple nations.

words.tr: v. 优化资源的使用；使资源利用达到最佳效果
words.ex: We must optimise the use of resources to save money.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须优化资源的使用以节省金钱。
words.en: To make the most efficient and effective use of available materials, energy, or assets.

words.tr: n. 技术辅助工具；科技援助设备
words.ex: The teacher used technological aid to explain the lesson.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用了技术辅助工具来讲解课程。
words.en: Technological aid: Assistance provided through advanced tools, systems, or knowledge.

words.tr: phrase. 提供经济援助；给予财政资助
words.ex: The government will provide financial assistance to poor families.
words.ex_cn: 政府将向贫困家庭提供经济援助。
words.en: To give financial help or support to someone or something.

words.tr: 受金融危机影响的国家
words.ex: Some countries affected by financial crisis lost many jobs.
words.ex_cn: 一些受金融危机影响的国家失去了许多工作。
words.en: Nations experiencing significant economic instability and hardship.

words.tr: 拥有先进环境技术的国家
words.ex: Countries with advanced environmental technology reduce pollution effectively.
words.ex_cn: 拥有先进环保技术的国家能有效减少污染。
words.en: Nations that possess sophisticated and leading-edge technology for environmental protection and sustainability.

words.tr: v. 缩小（规模）；裁员
words.ex: The company will downsize next month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司下个月将裁员。
words.en: If a company or organization downsizes, it reduces the number of people it employs in order to reduce costs or improve efficiency.

words.tr: n. 销售额下降；销量下滑
words.ex: The sales decline last month was big.
words.ex_cn: 上个月的销售额下降了很多。
words.en: A decrease in the volume of goods or services sold over a specific period.

words.tr: phrase. 跨国公司；在多个国家经营的大型企业
words.ex: Multinational companies hire workers from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 跨国公司从许多国家雇佣员工。
words.en: Companies that operate in several countries.

words.tr: phrase. 创造就业机会
words.ex: The new factory will create job opportunities for local people.
words.ex_cn: 这家新工厂将为当地人创造就业机会。
words.en: To make new employment possibilities available, especially by establishing new businesses or industries.

words.tr: n. 外资企业的扩张；外国公司的扩展
words.ex: The expansion of foreign companies is growing fast in China.
words.ex_cn: 外国公司的扩张在中国增长迅速。
words.en: The process of foreign corporations establishing or increasing their operations in a country.

words.tr: n. 国内投资（指在一国境内进行的投资活动）
words.ex: The government encourages domestic investment.
words.ex_cn: 政府鼓励国内投资。
words.en: Financial investment made within a country's own economy by its citizens or companies.

words.tr: phrase. 外国直接投资；指一国投资者在另一国建立企业或购买企业股份并取得经营控制权的投资行为
words.ex: The government is encouraging foreign direct investment to boost the economy.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在鼓励外国直接投资以促进经济发展。
words.en: Foreign direct investment (FDI) is an investment made by a company or individual in one country in business interests in another country, in the form of either establishing business operations or acquiring business assets in the other country, such as ownership or controlling interest in a foreign company.

words.tr: n. 外资流入；外国资本的涌入
words.ex: The country saw an influx of foreign capital last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年，这个国家看到了大量外国资本的涌入。
words.en: A large inflow of money from other countries into the domestic economy.

words.tr: phrase. 激烈的竞争；强劲的角逐
words.ex: There is fierce competition for the job.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Intense rivalry for limited opportunities or positions.

words.tr: phrase. 国际贸易
words.ex: He works in international trade.
words.ex_cn: 他从事国际贸易。
words.en: The exchange of goods and services between countries.

words.tr: n. 最新且先进的技术
words.ex: The company uses the latest and advanced technology to make phones.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用最新且先进的技术来制造手机。
words.en: The most recent and highly developed technological methods and equipment.

words.w: reduce the tax burden on local businesses
words.tr: 减轻本地企业的税收负担

words.us: rɪˈduːs ðə tæks ˈbɜːrdn ɑːn ˈloʊkl ˈbɪznəsɪz
words.ex: The government wants to reduce the tax burden on local businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府希望减轻本地企业的税收负担。
words.en: To lower the amount of tax that local companies are required to pay.

words.w: promote the growth of local businesses
words.tr: 促进本地企业的发展
words.uk: prəˈməʊt ðə ɡrəʊθ ɒv ˈləʊkl ˈbɪznɪsɪz
words.us: prəˈmoʊt ðə ɡroʊθ ʌv ˈloʊkl ˈbɪznɪsɪz
words.ex: The government gives money to promote the growth of local businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供资金以促进本地企业的成长。
words.en: To encourage and support the development and success of businesses operating within the country.

words.tr: n. 对外国公司的经济依赖
words.ex: The country has economic dependence on foreign companies.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家在经济上依赖外国公司。
words.en: Economic dependence on foreign companies: Reliance on external corporations for financial stability or resources.

words.tr: phrase. 向外国投资者征税
words.ex: The government collects taxes from foreign investors every year.
words.ex_cn: 政府每年向外国投资者征税。
words.en: To obtain money from foreign investors as a compulsory payment to the government.

words.tr: 增加公司税收入
words.ex: The government plans to increase corporate tax revenue next year.
words.ex_cn: 政府计划明年增加企业税收收入。
words.en: To raise the amount of money received by the government from taxes on corporate profits.

words.tr: n. 更广泛的产品范围
words.ex: The store now offers a broader range of products.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店现在提供更广泛的产品。
words.en: A broader range of products: A wider variety of goods available for selection or purchase.

words.tr: v. 刺激地方经济；促进本地经济发展
words.ex: The government gives money to stimulate local economies.
words.ex_cn: 政府提供资金以刺激地方经济。
words.en: Stimulate local economies: To encourage growth and activity within a community's financial system.

words.tr: v. 提高生活水平
words.ex: The new job will raise the standard of living for his family.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作将提高他家人的生活水平。
words.en: Raise standard of living: To improve the quality and comfort of people's daily lives.

words.w: drive their local competitors out of business
words.tr: v. 将他们的本地竞争对手挤出市场；迫使当地竞争者倒闭

words.us: draɪv ðer ˈloʊkl kəmˈpɛtɪtərz aʊt əv ˈbɪznəs

words.ex_cn: 这家大商店降价，把本地竞争对手赶出了市场。
words.en: Force nearby business rivals to cease operations.

words.w: exploit the natural and human resources of developing countries
words.tr: v. 剥削发展中国家的自然资源与人力资源

words.us: /ɪkˈsplɔɪt ðə ˈnætʃrəl ənd ˈhjumən ˈrisɔrsɪz əv dɪˈveləpɪŋ ˈkʌntriz/

words.tr: 变得更具创新性和竞争力
words.ex: The company works hard to become more innovative and competitive.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司努力变得更加创新和有竞争力。
words.en: Develop greater creativity and market effectiveness.

words.tr: n. 互补产业；指在生产、技术或市场上相互补充、协同发展的行业
words.ex: Tourism and hospitality are complementary industries.
words.ex_cn: 旅游业和酒店业是互补的产业。
words.en: Industries that mutually support each other by providing inputs or services, enhancing overall economic efficiency.

words.tr: v. 振兴经济；使经济复苏
words.ex: The government wants to revive the economy with low taxes.
words.ex_cn: 政府想通过低税收来振兴经济。
words.en: Restore economic activity and prosperity.

words.tr: n. 本地公司的增长
words.ex: The growth of local companies helps the economy.
words.ex_cn: 本地公司的增长有助于经济发展。
words.en: Expansion of businesses within a specific region.

words.tr: n. 本地竞争对手；地方上的对手
words.ex: The two local rivals compete for customers every day.
words.ex_cn: 这两个本地对手每天都在争夺顾客。
words.en: Businesses competing within the same geographical area.

words.tr: n. 薪资过低的员工；报酬不足的雇员
words.ex: The company treats underpaid employees unfairly.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司不公平地对待薪酬过低的员工。
words.en: Workers who receive wages below a fair or legally mandated level, often leading to exploitation or dissatisfaction.

words.tr: phrase. 加班；超时工作
words.ex: He works overtime to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他加班赚更多钱。
words.en: To work beyond the regular working hours, often to complete tasks or meet deadlines.

words.tr: n. 劳动规则与法规；指规范劳动关系、工作条件、雇员权利与义务等方面的法律和制度
words.ex: The factory follows labour rules and regulations to protect workers.
words.ex_cn: 工厂遵守劳动法规来保护工人。
words.en: Laws and guidelines governing employment conditions, worker rights, and workplace safety within a country or region.

words.tr: phrase. 保护小型企业
words.ex: The government helps to protect small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府帮助保护小企业。
words.en: To protect small businesses means to take measures to safeguard them from harm, competition, or economic challenges, ensuring their survival and growth.

words.tr: n. 国家之间的接触或联系
words.ex: There is contact between countries through trade.
words.ex_cn: 国家之间通过贸易保持联系。
words.en: Interactions, trade, or diplomatic relations between different nations, fostering cooperation or exchange.

words.tr: 不断增加的跨文化活动
words.ex: The school is increasing cross-cultural activities for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校正在为学生增加跨文化活动。
words.en: Rising exchanges between different cultures.

words.tr: n. 国家间日益增长的商业合作
words.ex: Countries are increasing business collaboration between them to grow their economies.
words.ex_cn: 各国正在加强彼此之间的商业合作以促进经济发展。
words.en: Growing cooperative ventures among nations.

words.tr: n. 经济合作
words.ex: The two countries signed a deal for economic cooperation.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家签署了一项经济合作的协议。
words.en: Collaborative efforts between nations or entities to enhance mutual economic growth through shared policies, trade agreements, and resource management.

words.tr: n. 交易活动；贸易活动
words.ex: The company records all trading activities every day.
words.ex_cn: 公司每天记录所有交易活动。
words.en: Commercial exchanges involving buying and selling.

words.tr: v. 损害国家认同；削弱民族身份认同
words.ex: The law may impair national identity.
words.ex_cn: 这项法律可能会损害国家认同。
words.en: Damage or weaken a nation's sense of self.

words.tr: phrase. 国际贸易
words.ex: He works in international trade.
words.ex_cn: 他从事国际贸易。
words.en: The exchange of goods and services between countries.

words.tr: v. 应对全球性问题；着手解决全球性难题
words.ex: Countries must tackle global problems together.
words.ex_cn: 各国必须共同应对全球性问题。
words.en: Address and resolve worldwide challenges.

words.tr: phrase. 生活消费品
words.ex: He buys consumer goods every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周都购买消费品。
words.en: Goods that are bought and used by consumers, rather than by manufacturers for producing other goods.

words.tr: phrase. 日常必需品；日常生活所需的物品
words.ex: The store sells a variety of daily necessities.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售各种生活必需品。
words.en: Daily necessities refer to the basic items required for everyday living, such as food, clothing, and household goods.

words.tr: n. 教育交流项目；指不同国家或地区之间为促进教育合作与文化交流而设立的互派学生、教师或研究人员的计划
words.ex: Students join educational exchange programmes to learn in other countries.
words.ex_cn: 学生参加教育交流项目到其他国家学习。
words.en: Structured programs that facilitate learning and cultural sharing between students or institutions across countries.

words.tr: 被运送到世界各地
words.ex: The toys were shipped around the world.
words.ex_cn: 这些玩具被运往世界各地。
words.en: Sent or distributed globally, often referring to goods, media, or information being available worldwide.

words.tr: n. 国际媒体公司
words.ex: International media companies broadcast news around the world.
words.ex_cn: 国际媒体公司向全球播送新闻。
words.en: Large corporations that produce and distribute news, entertainment, and other media content across multiple countries.

words.tr: phrase. 休闲娱乐活动
words.ex: He enjoys leisure activities on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他周末喜欢从事休闲活动。
words.en: Leisure activities refer to activities done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr: phrase. 减少文化多样性；削弱文化多元性
words.ex: The policy may reduce cultural diversity in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这项政策可能会减少城市中的文化多样性。
words.en: To lessen the variety of cultural expressions, practices, and beliefs within a community or society.

words.tr: n. 本土文化产业；国内文化工业（指一个国家内部从事文化产品创作、生产与传播的行业集合，如影视、音乐、出版、艺术等）
words.ex: The government supports domestic cultural industries to protect local traditions.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持国内文化产业以保护本地传统。
words.en: Industries within a single nation that create and distribute cultural products like films, music, and books for domestic audiences.

words.tr: phrase. 好莱坞大片；指由好莱坞制作、投资巨大、票房收入高的热门电影
words.ex: He loves watching hollywood blockbusters on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在周末看好莱坞大片。
words.en: High-budget, widely released films from Hollywood, often characterized by mass appeal and global marketing campaigns.

words.tr: n. 贸易壁垒的消除；取消贸易障碍
words.ex: The government supports the removal of trade barriers.
words.ex_cn: 政府支持消除贸易壁垒。
words.en: The reduction or elimination of government restrictions on trade between countries, such as tariffs or quotas.

words.tr: n. 全球文化同质化；全球文化的趋同现象
words.ex: Many people worry about global cultural sameness because movies and clothes look the same everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 许多人担心全球文化同质化，因为电影和衣服在各地都看起来一样。
words.en: The trend where cultures worldwide become increasingly similar, often due to the spread of global media and consumer products.

words.tr: phrase. 文化同质化；文化趋同
words.ex: Global media causes cultural homogenisation in many countries.
words.ex_cn: 全球媒体导致许多国家出现文化同质化。
words.en: The process by which distinct local cultures become more alike, typically through the influence of globalized media and commerce.

words.tr: v. 过着相似的生活方式
words.ex: They lead similar lifestyles because they both work long hours and eat healthy food.
words.ex_cn: 他们过着相似的生活方式，因为他们都工作很长时间并且吃健康的食物。
words.en: Adopt similar ways of living, often in terms of consumption habits or cultural practices.

words.tr: adj. 独特的传统；具有特色的习俗
words.ex: The village has distinctive traditions every spring.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄每年春天都有独特的传统。
words.en: Unique customs, arts, or practices that characterize a particular society or community, setting it apart from others.

words.tr: n. 经济与文化全球化
words.ex: Economic and cultural globalisation connects countries through trade and movies.
words.ex_cn: 经济和文化全球化通过贸易和电影连接各国。
words.en: The increasing interconnectedness of economies and cultures worldwide.

words.tr: 拥有更多的购物选择
words.ex: Online stores help people have more shopping choices.
words.ex_cn: 网上商店帮助人们有更多购物选择。
words.en: To have a greater variety of products and services available for purchase, often due to increased market competition and globalization.

words.w: erode the cultural identities of countries
words.tr: 侵蚀各国的文化认同
words.uk: ɪˈrəʊd ðə ˈkʌltʃərəl aɪˈdentɪtiz ɒv ˈkʌntriz
words.us: ɪˈroʊd ðə ˈkʌltʃərəl aɪˈdentətiz ʌv ˈkʌntriz
words.ex: Globalization can erode the cultural identities of countries.
words.ex_cn: 全球化可能会削弱各国的文化认同。
words.en: Gradually weaken or destroy the unique cultural characteristics of nations.

words.tr: n. 凝聚性强的群体；具有内聚力的团体
words.ex: The children formed cohesive groups to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们组成了团结的小组来完成项目。
words.en: Groups whose members are united by strong bonds and a shared sense of purpose.

words.tr: v. 削弱他们自身的文化；贬低他们自己的文化
words.ex: They try not to diminish their own culture.
words.ex_cn: 他们努力不削弱自己的文化。
words.en: To reduce or weaken the importance or distinctiveness of one's own cultural heritage.

words.w: erode their sense of cultural identity
words.tr: v. 侵蚀他们的文化认同感
words.uk: ɪˈrəʊd ðeə sens ɒv ˈkʌltʃərəl aɪˈdentəti
words.us: ɪˈroʊd ðer sens əv ˈkʌltʃərəl aɪˈdentəti
words.ex: The children lost their language, and it began to erode their sense of cultural identity.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们失去了他们的语言，这开始削弱他们的文化认同感。
words.en: To weaken or damage an individual's or group's feeling of belonging to a specific culture.

words.w: enrich a country ' s own culture
words.tr: v. 丰富一个国家自身的文化
words.uk: ɪnˈrɪtʃ ə ˈkʌntri z əʊn ˈkʌltʃə(r)
words.us: ɪnˈrɪtʃ ə ˈkʌntri z oʊn ˈkʌltʃər
words.ex: They use art to enrich a country's own culture.
words.ex_cn: 他们用艺术来丰富本国的文化。
words.en: to enhance and develop the cultural heritage and identity of a nation.

words.tr: n. 对自己国家的忠诚；爱国忠诚
words.ex: He shows loyalty toward his country by serving in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他通过服兵役来表达对祖国的忠诚。
words.en: A strong feeling of support, allegiance, and commitment to one's nation.

words.tr: phrase. 功能分区
words.ex: The city uses functional zoning to separate homes from factories.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市使用功能分区将住宅与工厂分开。
words.en: Functional zoning refers to the division of land into different areas for specific purposes, such as residential, commercial, or industrial use, to ensure efficient and organized urban development.

words.tr: n. 街道的布局；街道的规划
words.ex: The layout of streets in this town is simple and easy to follow.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇的街道布局简单且容易遵循。
words.en: The arrangement or design of streets in a town or city.

words.tr: n. 商业区；用于商业活动的区域
words.ex: The city built a commercial zone near the highway.
words.ex_cn: 城市在高速公路附近建了一个商业区。
words.en: An area of a town or city where commercial activities, such as shopping, are concentrated.

words.tr: n. 居住区；住宅区
words.ex: The city made this area a residential zone.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市把这个区域划为住宅区。
words.en: An area designated primarily for housing, often with residential buildings and related infrastructure.

words.tr: phrase. 办公楼；写字楼
words.ex: Many office buildings in the city have been equipped with solar panels.
words.ex_cn: n. 城市中的许多办公楼都安装了太阳能板。
words.en: Buildings that are used for office work, typically containing multiple offices for different companies or departments.

words.tr: phrase. 商业建筑；用于商业用途的建筑物，如办公楼、商店、购物中心等
words.ex: The city is planning to construct more commercial buildings to boost the economy.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划建造更多的商业建筑以促进经济发展。
words.en: Commercial buildings are structures used for business activities, such as offices, retail stores, and restaurants.

words.tr: phrase. 工业建筑
words.ex: The old industrial buildings are now empty.
words.ex_cn: 这些旧的工业建筑现在空着。
words.en: Buildings used for industrial purposes, such as manufacturing, production, or storage.

words.tr: n. 工业设施；工业厂房（指用于制造、加工或生产产品的建筑物和设备）
words.ex: The factory closed many industrial facilities last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这家工厂关闭了许多工业设施。
words.en: Factories, plants, and other structures used for manufacturing and production.

words.tr: adj. 不兼容的；不相配的；
words.ex: The software is incompatible with old systems.
words.ex_cn: 这个软件与旧系统不兼容。
words.en: If one thing or person is incompatible with another, they are very different in important ways, and do not suit each other or agree with each other.

words.tr: phrase. 公害；妨害公众的滋扰行为（指干扰公众权利或危害公共健康、安全、道德或福利的行为）
words.ex: The loud music at night is a public nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的嘈杂音乐是一种公共骚扰。
words.en: Anything that is harmful or annoying to the public, such as noise, pollution, or litter.

words.tr: phrase. 土地利用；土地使用方式
words.ex: The city changed the land use from farm to park.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市将土地用途从农田改为公园。
words.en: The way land is used or allocated for specific purposes, such as agriculture, housing, or industry.

words.tr: v. 比较商品（指对不同商品的质量、价格、性能等方面进行对比）
words.ex: He compares goods before he buys.
words.ex_cn: 他在购买前比较商品。
words.en: To examine and evaluate different products to determine their relative quality, price, or value.

words.tr: n. 服务与价格
words.ex: The shop shows services and prices on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 商店在墙上展示了服务和价格。
words.en: Services offered and their associated costs.

words.tr: n. 配套设施；辅助设施
words.ex: The school has supporting facilities like libraries and labs.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校有图书馆和实验室等配套设施。
words.en: Services or structures that enable or enhance the functionality of a main facility, such as utilities or transport links.

words.tr: phrase. 生活质量
words.ex: Good healthcare improves the quality of life.
words.ex_cn: 良好的医疗改善了生活质量。
words.en: The standard of health, comfort, and happiness experienced by an individual or group.

words.tr: n. 博物馆和美术馆
words.ex: We visited museums and art galleries on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日参观了博物馆和艺术画廊。
words.en: Places where art and historical artifacts are displayed.

words.tr: phrase. 音乐厅；演奏厅（用于举办音乐会的场所）
words.ex: Many people go to concert halls to listen to music.
words.ex_cn: 许多人去音乐厅听音乐。
words.en: A concert hall is a building designed for the performance of classical music concerts. It typically features excellent acoustics and a large seating capacity.

words.tr: v. 提供多种多样的……
words.ex: The market provides a wide variety of fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 市场提供各种各样的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: To offer a large and diverse range of options.

words.w: reduce their operating and maintenance costs
words.tr: v. 降低他们的运营和维护成本
words.uk: rɪˈdjuːs ðeə ˈɒpəreɪtɪŋ ənd ˈmeɪntənəns kɒsts
words.us: rɪˈduːs ðer ˈɑːpəreɪtɪŋ ənd ˈmeɪntənəns kɔːsts
words.ex: The company uses new machines to reduce their operating and maintenance costs.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司使用新机器来降低其运营和维护成本。
words.en: Lower expenses associated with running and maintaining a business or operation, improving profitability or efficiency.

words.tr: 为了公共利益；为了大众福祉
words.ex: He works hard for the common good.
words.ex_cn: 他努力为公众利益工作。
words.en: For the benefit of the general public.

words.tr: phr. 在附近；在周围；大约（用于表示数量或程度的近似值）
words.ex: The park is in the neighbourhood.
words.ex_cn: 公园就在附近。
words.en: In the local area where people live.

words.tr: n. 一个住宅区；居民区
words.ex: He lives in a residential neighbourhood near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他住在公园附近的一个住宅区。
words.en: An area primarily consisting of homes for living.

words.tr: v. 提供商品或服务
words.ex: The company delivers goods or services on time.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司按时交付货物或服务。
words.en: To bring products or assistance to customers.

words.tr: v. 减少交通拥堵和污染
words.ex: The city plans to reduce traffic and pollution by building more bike lanes.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划通过建设更多的自行车道来减少交通和污染。
words.en: Lessen the amount of vehicles and environmental harm.

words.tr: phrase. 货物运输；指将商品或物品从一地运送到另一地的过程或行业
words.ex: The company handles goods transport by truck.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司用卡车运输货物。
words.en: The movement of goods, such as products or materials, from one location to another by road, rail, sea, or air.

words.tr: n. 大量的交通流量；高车流量
words.ex: There are high volumes of traffic on the highway during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 在高峰时段，高速公路上车流量很大。
words.en: A large number of vehicles on the road.

words.tr: n. 频繁的交通拥堵
words.ex: There is frequent traffic congestion in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 市中心经常出现交通拥堵。
words.en: Regular and heavy blockages of traffic flow.

words.tr: n. 竞争与价格战（指企业间为争夺市场份额而不断降低价格的商业行为）
words.ex: The two companies started a competition and price wars to get more customers.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司为了获得更多客户，展开了竞争和价格战。
words.en: Rivalry between businesses, often leading to reduced prices and profit margins.

words.tr: n. 消费者需求选择；指消费者根据自身偏好和预算在不同商品或服务之间做出的购买决策
words.ex: The store tracks consumer demand choice to stock popular items.
words.ex_cn: 商店追踪消费者需求选择以备货受欢迎的商品。
words.en: The wants and needs of people who purchase goods and services.

words.tr: phrase. 在短期内；从短期来看
words.ex: In the short term, we need more money to fix the car.
words.ex_cn: 短期内，我们需要更多钱来修车。
words.en: In the short term means for a brief period of time, not considering the distant future.

words.tr: n. 业务增长；企业成长
words.ex: The company shows strong business growth this year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司今年显示出强劲的业务增长。
words.en: The increase in a company's size, revenue, or market share over time.

words.tr: phrase. 经济发展
words.ex: The country wants economic development to help its people.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望经济发展来帮助人民。
words.en: Economic development refers to the process by which the economic well-being and quality of life of a nation, region, or local community are improved according to targeted goals and objectives.

words.tr: phrase. 发展潜力；开发潜能
words.ex: This town has great development potential.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有很大的发展潜力。
words.en: The capacity or ability of a person, organization, or area to grow, improve, or expand in the future.

words.tr: n. 先前存在的结构
words.ex: The new building was built on previously existing structures.
words.ex_cn: 这座新建筑建在原有的结构上。
words.en: Buildings, systems, or frameworks that were already in place before a new development or change.

words.tr: n. 分区标准；用地分区规范（指政府为规范土地使用而制定的法规和标准）
words.ex: The city set new zoning standards for buildings.
words.ex_cn: 城市为建筑物制定了新的分区标准。
words.en: Regulations that dictate how land in a specific area can be used, such as for residential, commercial, or industrial purposes.

words.w: optimise the use of available resources
words.tr: v. 优化可用资源的使用；使现有资源的利用达到最佳效果
words.uk: ˈɒptɪmaɪz ðə juːz ɒv əˈveɪləbl ˈriːsɔːsɪz
words.us: ˈɑːptɪmaɪz ðə juːz ʌv əˈveɪləbl ˈriːsɔːrsɪz
words.ex: We must optimise the use of available resources to save money.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须优化现有资源的使用以节省金钱。
words.en: To make the most efficient and effective use of the resources that are available.

words.tr: phrase. 拆除旧建筑
words.ex: They will demolish old buildings next month.
words.ex_cn: 他们下个月会拆除旧建筑。
words.en: To completely destroy or tear down old structures, typically to make way for new development.

words.tr: phrase. 为...腾出空位
words.ex: Please make room for the new chair.
words.ex_cn: 请给新椅子腾出空间。
words.en: To create space or opportunity for someone or something.

words.tr: n. 远程学习；远程教育（指通过互联网或其他通信技术进行的非面对面教学形式）
words.ex: He is doing remote learning at home.
words.ex_cn: 他正在家里进行远程学习。
words.en: Education that takes place remotely, often via the internet.

words.tr: phrase. 信息技术
words.ex: He works in information technology at a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司从事信息技术工作。
words.en: Information technology refers to the use of computers, storage, networking and other physical devices, infrastructure and processes to create, process, store, secure and exchange all forms of electronic data.

words.tr: v. 发挥重要作用；产生影响
words.uk: pleɪ ən ɪmˈpɔːtnt rəʊl meɪk ə ˈdɪfrəns
words.us: pleɪ ən ɪmˈpɔːrtnt roʊl meɪk ə ˈdɪfrəns
words.ex: She plays an important role and makes a difference in her school.
words.ex_cn: 她在学校里扮演重要角色，并产生影响。
words.en: To have a significant and positive effect on a situation.

words.tr: phrase. 激发好奇心；唤起求知欲
words.ex: The teacher's story inspired curiosity in the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师的故事激发了学生的好奇心。
words.en: To stimulate or arouse interest and a desire to learn.

words.tr: phrase. 识字率；读写能力普及率
words.ex: The government aims to increase the literacy rate by implementing new educational programs.
words.ex_cn: 政府旨在通过实施新的教育计划来提高识字率。
words.en: The percentage of people in a given population who have the ability to read and write.

words.tr: phrase. 课外活动（指学校课程以外的活动，如体育、社团、艺术等）
words.ex: He joins extra-curriculum activities after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后参加课外活动。
words.en: Activities that fall outside the realm of the normal curriculum of school or university education, often aimed at developing skills or interests.

words.tr: n. 自律；自我控制
words.ex: He shows self-control when he stops eating sweets.
words.ex_cn: 当他停止吃糖果时，他表现出了自律。
words.en: The ability to control one's own actions and impulses, especially in the face of temptation or distraction.

words.tr: n. 情绪健康；情感福祉健康（指个体在情绪和心理层面的良好状态）
words.ex: She eats well and sleeps enough for her emotional wellbeinghealth.
words.ex_cn: 她饮食健康、睡眠充足，以保持情绪健康。
words.en: The state of being mentally and emotionally healthy and resilient, capable of managing life's stresses.

words.tr: phrase. 在线资源；网络资源
words.ex: The internet provides a vast amount of online resources for learning new skills.
words.ex_cn: 互联网为学习新技能提供了大量的在线资源。
words.en: Online resources refer to information, tools, and services that are accessible via the internet, used for various purposes such as education, research, and entertainment.

words.tr: phrase. 全面发展；整体发展；综合开发
words.ex: The program helps with the overall development of children.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目有助于儿童的全面发展。
words.en: The process of growing or causing something to grow or become more advanced or elaborate in all aspects.

words.tr: phrase. 社会技能
words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 学术资格；学历
words.ex: He needs an academic qualification to get the job.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一份学术资格才能获得这份工作。
words.en: An academic qualification is an official document showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study or passed an examination.

words.tr: phrase. 跟上
words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.tr: v. 将...付诸实践；应用于实际
words.ex: We need to apply this theory into practice.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要将这个理论付诸实践。
words.en: To put a theory, plan, or idea into actual use or effect.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 拓宽视野；扩展眼界（常用于比喻意义，指增长见识或经验）
words.ex: Traveling helps you expand your horizon.
words.ex_cn: 旅行能帮助你拓宽视野。
words.en: To increase the range of one's knowledge, experience, or understanding.

words.tr: phrase. 成就感
words.ex: He felt a sense of achievement after finishing the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在完成比赛后感到一种成就感。
words.en: A feeling of satisfaction that you have achieved something important or difficult.

words.tr: adj. 以工作为导向的；注重实践的；专业的；职业的
words.ex: He chose a work-oriented practical job as a professional occupational therapist.
words.ex_cn: 他选择了一份以工作为导向的实用职业，成为一名专业的职业治疗师。
words.en: relating to or characterized by a focus on work, practicality, and professional duties.

words.tr:
n. 纪律；学科；科目；训练；惩戒；
v. 约束自己；
words.ex: The teacher enforced discipline in the classroom.
words.ex_cn: 老师在教室里维持纪律。
words.en: Discipline is the practice of making people obey rules or standards of behaviour, and punishing them when they do not.

words.tr: phrase. 教育机会；学习和接受教育的可能性或途径
words.ex: Children in rural areas need more educational opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 农村的孩子需要更多的教育机会。
words.en: Educational opportunities refer to the chances or possibilities for individuals to receive education, which can include formal schooling, training programs, or other forms of learning.

words.tr: v. 歧视学生
words.ex: The school must not discriminate against students because of their race.
words.ex_cn: 学校不得因学生的种族而歧视他们。
words.en: To treat a person or group unfairly or prejudicially, especially based on characteristics like race or gender.

words.tr: phrase. 单性别学校（指只招收男生或只招收女生的学校）
words.ex: He goes to a single-sex school with only boys.
words.ex_cn: 他上一所只收男生的单性别学校。
words.en: Schools that admit students of only one sex.

words.tr: phrase. 实行男女同校的学校；混合教育的学校
words.ex: They go to coeducational schools with boys and girls together.
words.ex_cn: 他们上男女同校的学校，男孩和女孩在一起学习。
words.en: Schools where both male and female students are educated together.

words.tr: phrase. 一对一课程；私人授课
words.ex: He takes one-to-one lessons with his English teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他和他的英语老师上一对一课程。
words.en: Educational or instructional sessions conducted individually between one teacher and one student.

words.w: at his or her own pace
words.tr: adv. 按照他或她自己的速度；以自己的步调
words.uk: æt hɪz ɔː(r) hɜː(r) əʊn peɪs
words.us: æt hɪz ɔːr hɜːr oʊn peɪs
words.ex: He learns math at his own pace.
words.ex_cn: 他按照自己的节奏学习数学。
words.en: At a speed or rate that is comfortable and suitable for the individual.

words.tr: n. 家庭教育；在家上学（指家长在家中对孩子进行教学，而非送入学校）
words.ex: They are doing home-schooling for their children.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在为孩子进行家庭教育。
words.en: Educational instruction provided at home by parents or tutors instead of in a formal school.

words.tr: phrase. 私人导师；家庭教师；个别辅导老师
words.ex: Many parents hire private tutors to help their children with their studies.
words.ex_cn: 许多家长聘请私人教师来帮助他们的孩子学习。
words.en: Private tutors are individuals who provide personalized educational instruction to students outside of the traditional classroom setting.

words.tr: n. 上课的节奏；上课的频率或速度
words.ex: The tempo of attending classes is too fast for me.
words.ex_cn: 上课的节奏对我而言太快了。
words.en: The speed or pace at which classes are attended, often referring to the frequency or regularity of attendance.

words.tr: v. 有机会进行内省；有机会反思自己的思想或情感
words.ex: He has an opportunity to introspect during his quiet walk.
words.ex_cn: 他在安静散步时有机会自我反思。
words.en: To have the chance to examine one's own thoughts, feelings, and actions in a thoughtful way.

words.tr: phrase. 无薪工作；无偿劳动
words.ex: She does unpaid work at a local shelter.
words.ex_cn: 她在当地收容所做无偿工作。
words.en: Work for which no payment is received.

words.tr: phrase. 义务教育
words.ex: Children must attend compulsory education until age 16.
words.ex_cn: 儿童必须接受义务教育直到16岁。
words.en: Compulsory education refers to a period of education that is required of all people and is imposed by the government.

words.tr: phrase. 实用技能；实践技能
words.ex: He learned practical skills in the workshop.
words.ex_cn: 他在工坊里学到了实用技能。
words.en: Practical skills refer to the abilities that are useful in everyday life or in a particular job, especially those that involve manual or technical tasks.

words.tr: adj. 以学习者为中心的
words.ex: The teacher uses learner-oriented methods to help students.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用以学习者为中心的方法来帮助学生。
words.en: Designed or intended to meet the learning needs and preferences of students.

words.tr: phrase. 激发兴趣；引起关注
words.ex: The teacher used colorful visuals to stimulate interest in the subject.
words.ex_cn: 老师使用丰富多彩的视觉材料来激发学生对这个科目的兴趣。
words.en: To stimulate interest means to encourage or arouse curiosity or enthusiasm in something.

words.tr: 短语. 鼓励想象力和创造力
words.ex: Teachers should encourage imagination and creativity in students.
words.ex_cn: 老师应该鼓励学生的想象力和创造力。
words.en: To foster original thinking and the generation of new ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 逻辑思维；逻辑思考
words.ex: He uses logical thinking to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑思维解决数学问题。
words.en: Logical thinking involves the process of reasoning in a structured and coherent manner to solve problems or make decisions.

words.tr: adj. 有趣的；使人愉快的； v. 款待；“entertain”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an entertaining show.
words.ex_cn: 小丑表演了一场有趣的节目。
words.en: Providing amusement or enjoyment.

words.tr: phrase. 识字率；读写能力普及率
words.ex: The government aims to increase the literacy rate by implementing new educational programs.
words.ex_cn: 政府旨在通过实施新的教育计划来提高识字率。
words.en: The percentage of people in a given population who have the ability to read and write.

words.tr: phrase. 提供良好的榜样示范；树立正面的典范
words.ex: Teachers should provide good role modelling for students.
words.ex_cn: 老师应该为学生树立良好的榜样。
words.en: To serve as a positive example for others to follow through one's own behavior and actions.

words.tr: phrase. 塑造个性；影响人格形成
words.ex: He tried to shape his personality to fit the group.
words.ex_cn: 他试图塑造自己的个性以适应这个群体。
words.en: To influence or determine the development of one's character and traits.

words.w: learn the difference between right and wrong
words.tr: phrase. 学会分辨是非；明白对错之间的区别
words.uk: /lɜːn ðə ˈdɪfrəns bɪˈtwiːn raɪt ænd wrɒŋ/
words.us: /lɜrn ðə ˈdɪfrəns bɪˈtwiːn raɪt ænd wrɑːŋ/
words.ex: Children learn the difference between right and wrong from their parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们从父母那里学习对与错的区别。
words.en: To understand what is morally correct and what is not.

words.tr: phrase. 获得、获取知识和技能
words.uk: əbˈteɪn əˈkwaɪə ɡeɪn ˈnɒlɪdʒ ənd skɪlz
words.us: əbˈteɪn əˈkwaɪr ɡeɪn ˈnɑːlɪdʒ ənd skɪlz
words.ex: He works hard to obtain knowledge and skills.
words.ex_cn: 他努力获得知识和技能。
words.en: to gain or achieve understanding, information, or abilities through experience or study.

words.w: enrich one's social and life experience
words.tr: phrase. 丰富某人的社交和生活经验
words.ex: Traveling helps her enrich her social and life experience.
words.ex_cn: 旅行帮助她丰富社交和生活经验。
words.en: To broaden and deepen one's personal and interpersonal experiences.

words.tr: 尊重并遵守规则
words.ex: Students must respect and obey the rules in class.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须尊重并遵守课堂规则。
words.en: To treat rules with consideration and follow them without question or resistance.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.w: a valuable member of any community
words.tr: phrase. 任何社区中的一位宝贵成员
words.uk: ə ˈvæljuəbl ˈmɛmbər ɒv ˈɛni kəˈmjuːnɪti
words.us: ə ˈvæljuəbəl ˈmɛmbər ʌv ˈɛni kəˈmjunəti
words.ex: He is a valuable member of any community.
words.ex_cn: 他是任何一个社区的宝贵成员。
words.en: A person who contributes significantly and is respected within a group.

words.tr: phrase. 承担责任；负起责任
words.ex: He will take responsibility for his actions.
words.ex_cn: 他将为自己的行为负责。
words.en: To accept that you are the person who should deal with something or take care of someone.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的育儿方式；有效的父母教养
words.ex: Good parenting helps children feel safe and loved.
words.ex_cn: 良好的育儿方式让孩子感到安全和被爱。
words.en: The practice of raising children with love, discipline, and support to foster their development and well-being.

words.tr: phrase. 积极的活动；活跃的行动
words.ex: He is doing an active activity every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都进行一项活跃的活动。
words.en: The state of being engaged in energetic or busy pursuits.

words.tr: phrase. 增加注意力持续时间；延长专注时间
words.ex: He does puzzles to increase attention span.
words.ex_cn: 他做拼图来提高注意力持续时间。
words.en: To extend the period of time one can concentrate on a task.

words.tr: phrase. 生动的图片；鲜明的图像；逼真的画面
words.ex: The story gave us vivid pictures of the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事让我们看到了森林的生动画面。
words.en: Clear, detailed, and lifelike images or descriptions.

words.tr: phrase. 鼓励冒险和探索
words.ex: Teachers should encourage risk taking and exploration in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师应该在课堂上鼓励冒险和探索。
words.en: Promote the willingness to try new things and investigate unknown areas.

words.tr: phrase. 攻击性行为
words.ex: The teacher noticed aggressive behaviours in the playground.
words.ex_cn: 老师在操场上注意到了攻击性行为。
words.en: Aggressive behaviours refer to actions or attitudes that are hostile or forceful, often intended to dominate or intimidate others.

words.tr: phrase. 社会隔离；社交孤立；指个体与社会缺乏联系或互动的状态
words.ex: He feels social isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到社交孤立。
words.en: Social isolation is the state of complete or near-complete lack of contact between an individual and society. It can be a risk factor for mental and physical health problems.

words.tr: n. 近视；目光短浅
words.ex: He has shortsightedness and needs glasses to see far.
words.ex_cn: 他有近视，需要戴眼镜才能看远。
words.en: Shortsightedness refers to the condition of being unable to see distant objects clearly, or the inability to foresee the long-term consequences of actions.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；对…上瘾
words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: phrase. 社会技能
words.ex: He is improving his social skills at work.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工作中提升自己的社交技能。
words.en: Social skills are the skills we use to communicate and interact with each other, both verbally and non-verbally, through gestures, body language and our personal appearance.

words.tr: phrase. 信息缺乏真实性；信息不真实
words.ex: The article has no authenticity of the information.
words.ex_cn: 这篇文章的信息没有真实性。
words.en: The lack of reliability or truthfulness in given data or facts.

words.tr: phrase. 教师的指导；老师的引导
words.ex: The guidance of the teachers helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师的指导帮助他通过了考试。
words.en: The advice, support, and instruction provided by teachers to help students learn.

words.tr: n. 课程
words.ex: The school changed its curriculum last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年学校更改了课程。
words.en: A curriculum is the subjects that are studied in a school, college, or university.

words.tr: phrase. 提供更多工作机会
words.ex: The new factory will provide more job opportunities.
words.ex_cn: 这家新工厂将提供更多的就业机会。
words.en: Create more employment possibilities for people.

words.tr: phrase. 学术表现；学业成绩
words.ex: His academic performance improved after he studied harder.
words.ex_cn: 他更努力学习后，学业表现提高了。
words.en: The achievement or success in academic studies or work, often measured by grades or other assessments.

words.tr: phrase. 对……充满热情的；热爱……的
words.ex_cn: 他热衷于打篮球。
words.en: To have a very strong interest in or enthusiasm for something.

words.tr: phrase. 识字率；读写能力普及率
words.ex: The government aims to increase the literacy rate by implementing new educational programs.
words.ex_cn: 政府旨在通过实施新的教育计划来提高识字率。
words.en: The percentage of people in a given population who have the ability to read and write.

words.tr: phrase. 减轻……的负担
words.ex: The government is taking steps to lighten the burden of taxes on small businesses.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在采取措施减轻小企业的税收负担。
words.en: To make a burden or problem less heavy or severe.

words.tr: phrase. 应试教育
words.ex: He suffers from exam-oriented education in high school.
words.ex_cn: 他在高中深受应试教育之苦。
words.en: An education system that places a strong emphasis on preparing students for exams, often at the expense of a more well-rounded education.

words.tr: v. 变得适应性强且灵活
words.ex: He became adaptable and flexible when he moved to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 当他搬到一个新国家时，他变得适应性强且灵活。
words.en: Develop the ability to adjust easily to new conditions and changes.

words.tr: adj. 高度合格的；非常有资格的
words.ex: He is a highly qualified teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位非常合格的老师。
words.en: Possessing exceptional skills, experience, or credentials for a specific role.

words.w: prepare themselves for the global society
words.tr: v. 使自己为全球社会做好准备
words.uk: prɪˈpeə ðəmˈselvz fɔː ðə ˈɡləʊbl səˈsaɪəti
words.us: prɪˈper ðəmˈsɛlvz fɔr ðə ˈɡloʊbl səˈsaɪəti
words.ex: Students must prepare themselves for the global society.
words.ex_cn: 学生必须为全球社会做好准备。
words.en: Equip themselves with the knowledge and mindset needed for an interconnected world.

words.tr: phrase. 选修科目；任选课程
words.ex: Students can choose optional subjects like art or music.
words.ex_cn: 学生可以选择艺术或音乐等选修课。
words.en: Optional subjects are courses that students can choose to take as part of their curriculum, but are not required.

words.tr: n. 理论科目；理论性学科
words.ex: He finds theoretical subjects hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得理论科目很难理解。
words.en: Academic disciplines focused on abstract concepts, principles, and theories rather than practical application.

words.tr: n. 一个坚实的理论基础
words.ex: He built a solid theoretical foundation in physics.
words.ex_cn: 他建立了坚实的物理理论基础。
words.en: A strong base of fundamental principles and knowledge.

words.w: a deep understanding of the concepts
words.tr: n. 对概念的深刻理解
words.uk: ə diːp ˌʌndəˈstændɪŋ ɒv ðə ˈkɒnsepts
words.us: ə diːp ˌʌndərˈstændɪŋ ʌv ðə ˈkɑːnsepts
words.ex: He has a deep understanding of the concepts in math.
words.ex_cn: 他对数学中的概念有深刻的理解。
words.en: A thorough and insightful grasp of key ideas and their relationships.

words.tr: phrase. 实用科目
words.ex: He likes practical subjects like cooking and carpentry.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢烹饪和木工这样的实用科目。
words.en: Subjects that are concerned with the actual doing or use of something rather than with theory and ideas.

words.tr: n. 应用技能；指将知识或技术实际运用于特定情境或任务中的能力
words.ex: He uses his application skills to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他运用自己的应用技能来解决数学问题。
words.en: The practical ability to use knowledge or techniques effectively.

words.w: demonstrate an actual way of working
words.tr: v. 展示一种实际的工作方式
words.uk: ˈdemənstreɪt ən ˈæktʃuəl weɪ əv ˈwɜːkɪŋ
words.us: ˈdemənstreɪt ən ˈæktʃuəl weɪ əv ˈwɜːrkɪŋ
words.ex: He demonstrates an actual way of working by finishing tasks on time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过按时完成任务展示了一种切实可行的工作方式。
words.en: Show a tangible, real-world method of completing tasks or solving problems.

words.tr: phrase. 整体发展；全面发展的过程，强调在身体、智力、情感和社会等方面协调进步
words.ex: The school focuses on holistic development of students.
words.ex_cn: 学校注重学生的全面发展。
words.en: Holistic development refers to the process of developing all aspects of a person, including physical, emotional, social, and intellectual growth.

words.tr: 短语。在学校层面；在中小学教育阶段
words.ex: Math is taught at school level.
words.ex_cn: 数学在中小学阶段教授。
words.en: Pertaining to the educational stage before university or college.

words.tr: phrase. 专业教育；专门教育
words.ex: He received specialized education in robotics.
words.ex_cn: 他接受了机器人领域的专业教育。
words.en: Education that focuses on a specific area of study or profession, providing in-depth knowledge and skills.

words.tr: phrase. 以就业为导向的培训；面向岗位需求的培训
words.ex: The company offers job-oriented training to enhance employees' skills.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供定向培训以提高员工的技能。
words.en: Training that is specifically designed to prepare individuals for employment, focusing on the skills and knowledge required for particular jobs.

words.w: broaden the horizon widen the horizon
words.tr: v. 拓宽视野；开阔眼界
words.uk: ˈbrɔːdn ðə ˈhɒraɪzn / ˈwaɪdn ðə ˈhɒraɪzn
words.us: ˈbrɔːdn ðə ˈhɔːrəzn / ˈwaɪdn ðə ˈhɔːrəzn
words.ex: Traveling abroad can broaden the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 出国旅行可以拓宽视野。
words.en: to expand one's range of knowledge, experience, or understanding.

words.tr: n. 流；溪；
words.ex: The stream flows quietly through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 小溪静静地流过森林。
words.en: A stream is a small, narrow river. It can also refer to a continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas, or a continuous flow of data or information.

words.tr: n. 最大利益；最高效益
words.ex: He gets the maximum benefits from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他从工作中获得了最大利益。
words.en: The highest level of advantages or gains achievable.

words.tr: phrase. 高压的；需要快速决策和高强度工作的
words.ex: He works under high pressure every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在高压下工作。
words.en: High pressure refers to a condition of the atmosphere in which the atmospheric pressure is higher than that of surrounding areas, often associated with clear weather.

words.tr: 失去动力
words.ex: He felt de-motivated after failing the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试失败后感到失去动力。
words.en: Having lost enthusiasm or motivation; discouraged.

words.tr: n. 自卑情结；自卑感
words.ex: This material is inferior to the complex one.
words.ex_cn: 这种材料比复杂的那种差。
words.en: A psychological state characterized by feelings of inadequacy and inferiority, often leading to compensatory behaviors.

words.tr: phrase. 竞争意识
words.ex: He has a sense of competition when he plays soccer.
words.ex_cn: 当他踢足球时，他有一种竞争意识。
words.en: The awareness or feeling of striving to gain or win something by defeating or establishing superiority over others.

words.tr: v. 提高就业能力；增强受雇用的可能性
words.ex: She takes courses to improve the employability.
words.ex_cn: 她上课以提高就业能力。
words.en: To enhance the skills and qualities that make someone more attractive to employers.

words.tr: phrase. 职业课程；职业技能培训课程
words.ex: He took vocational courses to learn carpentry.
words.ex_cn: 他上了职业课程来学习木工。
words.en: Educational programs focused on practical skills for specific trades or careers.

words.tr: phrase. 高等教育；第三级教育（指中学之后的大学或学院教育）
words.ex: He plans to go to tertiary education after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他计划在高中毕业后接受高等教育。
words.en: Tertiary education refers to the level of education that follows secondary education, including universities, colleges, and vocational schools, aimed at providing specialized knowledge and skills.

words.tr: n. 实践性科目；实用学科
words.ex: Science is a practical subject.
words.ex_cn: 科学是一门实用的科目。
words.en: A subject or area of study that focuses on applying theoretical knowledge to real-world situations, often involving hands-on skills and problem-solving.

words.tr: n. 工作场所；工作地点；
words.ex: The new safety rules apply to the workplace.
words.ex_cn: 新的安全规则适用于工作场所。
words.en: A workplace is a place where people work, such as an office or factory.

words.tr: phrase. 下一代；新一代；接班人
words.ex: The next generation of phones is faster and smarter.
words.ex_cn: 下一代手机更快更智能。
words.en: The term 'next generation' refers to the group of people, products, or technologies that come after the current one, often implying improvements or advancements.

words.tr: v. 遵守规则；服从规定
words.ex: The children obey the rules in class.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在课堂上遵守规则。
words.en: To follow the established regulations or laws.

words.tr: phrase. 价值体系；价值观系统
words.ex: The company's value system emphasizes integrity and customer satisfaction.
words.ex_cn: 公司的价值系统强调诚信和客户满意度。
words.en: The set of principles and standards that guide behavior and decision-making.

words.tr: phrase. 社区服务
words.ex: He does community service every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都做社区服务。
words.en: Community service is unpaid work that someone does to help other people in their community, often as a punishment for a crime.

words.tr: v. 与同事合作；与同事协作
words.ex: He co-operates with colleagues to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 他与同事合作完成项目。
words.en: Work together with coworkers in a coordinated and supportive manner to achieve common goals.

words.tr: phrase. 贡献；促成；导致；有助于
words.ex: Volunteers contribute to the clean-up of the park.
words.ex_cn: 志愿者们为公园的清洁做出了贡献。
words.en: If you contribute to something, you help to cause it or make it happen.

words.tr: phrase. 一种责任感；对某事负责的感觉或意识
words.ex: He has a sense of responsibility at work.
words.ex_cn: 他在工作中有责任感。
words.en: The feeling or consciousness of an obligation to do something or to behave in a certain way.

words.tr: phrase. 模范；榜样
words.ex: My teacher is my role model.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师是我的榜样。
words.en: A role model is a person whose behavior, example, or success is or can be emulated by others, especially by younger people.

words.tr: v. 被量身定制以满足个人需求；根据个人需要进行调整
words.ex: The program is tailored to individual needs.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目是根据个人需求定制的。
words.en: To be customized or adapted to suit the specific requirements of each person.

words.tr: v. 使兴趣相匹配；使兴趣一致
words.ex: He tries to match interest with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他试图与朋友的兴趣保持一致。
words.en: A situation where two or more parties have a mutual or compatible level of interest in something, such as a topic, activity, or goal.

words.tr: n. 自律；自我约束
words.ex: He shows self-discipline by waking up early every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早起展现自律。
words.en: The ability to control yourself and to make yourself work hard or behave in a particular way without needing anyone else to tell you what to do.

words.tr: phrase. 对社会有贡献的成员；能为社会创造价值的成员
words.ex: They work hard to be productive members of society.
words.ex_cn: 他们努力工作，成为对社会有贡献的人。
words.en: Individuals who contribute positively to the economy and community through their work, volunteerism, or other activities.

words.tr: phrase. 以自私的方式行事；表现得自私
words.ex: He behaves selfishly when he won't share his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当他不愿意分享玩具时，他以自私的方式行事。
words.en: To act in a way that prioritizes one's own advantage without regard for others.

words.tr: phrase. 被……所激励；由于……而产生动力
words.ex: He is motivated by his love for science.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对科学的热爱而受到激励。
words.en: To be driven or inspired by a particular reason or desire.

words.tr: phrase. 良好的礼仪；礼貌的行为
words.ex: He has good manners and says thank you often.
words.ex_cn: 他有礼貌，经常说谢谢。
words.en: Good manners are the socially acceptable ways of behaving and interacting with others, which include being polite, respectful, and considerate.

words.tr: n. 专业技能；专门技能
words.ex: He has a specialized skill in repairing computers.
words.ex_cn: 他有一项专门的电脑维修技能。
words.en: A specific ability or expertise acquired through focused training or experience, essential for performing particular tasks or roles effectively.

words.tr: phrase. 公民参与；指个人或群体参与社会公共事务、政治活动或社区服务的行为
words.ex: He joins civic engagement to help his community.
words.ex_cn: 他参与公民活动以帮助他的社区。
words.en: Active participation in community or political life.

words.tr: phrase. 以职业为导向的培训；旨在帮助个人发展特定职业技能的教育或训练
words.ex: The company offers career-oriented training programs to help employees advance in their fields.
words.ex_cn: 公司提供职业导向型培训项目，帮助员工在其领域内晋升。
words.en: Training that is specifically designed to prepare individuals for a particular career or profession.

words.tr: phrase. 精英教育
words.ex: Elite education focuses on nurturing the top talents in society.
words.ex_cn: n. 精英教育专注于培养社会上的顶尖人才。
words.en: Education provided to a select group of students who are considered to be the most talented or intellectually gifted.

words.tr: phrase. 利用；欺骗；占便宜
words.ex: He took advantage of the free tickets.
words.ex_cn: 他利用了免费的票。
words.en: To use a particular situation to do or get what you want.

words.tr: v. 在社会中立足；在社会中确立自己的地位
words.ex: They worked hard to establish themselves in society.
words.ex_cn: 他们努力工作，以便在社会中站稳脚跟。
words.en: To become accepted and integrated into a community or social group, often by building a reputation, network, or position of influence.

words.tr: n. 狭隘的观点；心胸狭窄的看法
words.ex: He has narrow-minded views about other cultures.
words.ex_cn: 他对其他文化有狭隘的看法。
words.en: Unwilling to consider different opinions or ideas; prejudiced and intolerant.

words.tr: phrase. 社会分化；社会阶层或群体之间的分裂
words.ex: The social division between the rich and the poor is becoming more pronounced.
words.ex_cn: n. 贫富之间的社会分化变得越来越明显。
words.en: A situation in which a society is split into groups with differing interests, often leading to conflict or lack of cohesion.

words.tr: phrase. 全面发展；均衡成长
words.ex: The school promotes rounded development in all students.
words.ex_cn: 学校促进所有学生的全面发展。
words.en: Comprehensive growth or improvement in various aspects, especially in the context of education or personal development.

words.tr: n. 塑造角色；角色塑造
words.ex: The shape of his character is honest and kind.
words.ex_cn: 他的性格特点是诚实和善良。
words.en: A distinctive quality or feature that defines or identifies a person, object, or concept, often used in literature or psychology to describe the defining traits of a character.

words.tr: phrase. 电子设备；电子装置
words.ex: He uses an electronic device to take notes.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子设备做笔记。
words.en: An electronic device is a device that accomplishes its purpose electronically.

words.tr: phrase. 高科技产品
words.ex: He bought a hi-tech product to help him work faster.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一件高科技产品来帮助他更快地工作。
words.en: A product that uses advanced technology.

words.tr: phrase. 落后的；过时的；跟不上时代潮流的
words.ex: He wears old clothes and is behind the times.
words.ex_cn: 他穿旧衣服，落伍了。
words.en: If you describe something as behind the times, you mean that it is old-fashioned and not aware of or using recent ideas or methods.

words.tr: phrase. 最新式的（或最新的）产品
words.ex: The store sells up-to-date products.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售最新的产品。
words.en: Products that are modern and incorporate the latest features or information.

words.tr: phrase. 沉迷于；对…上瘾
words.ex: He is addicted to playing video games.
words.ex_cn: 他沉迷于玩电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is addicted to something, they are unable to stop doing it or using it, even though it may be harmful to them.

words.tr: phrase. 中产阶级；社会中等收入和地位的阶层
words.ex: The middle class buys houses and sends children to school.
words.ex_cn: 中产阶级购买房子并送孩子上学。
words.en: The social class between the upper and working classes, typically associated with professionals and managers.

words.tr: phrase. 航空旅行；乘飞机旅行
words.ex: He likes air travel because it is fast.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢航空旅行，因为它很快。
words.en: The action or activity of traveling by aircraft.

words.tr: phrase. 自动化流程；使过程自动化
words.ex: The factory will automate the process next year.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂明年将自动化这个过程。
words.en: To implement technology that performs tasks with minimal human intervention.

words.tr: phrase. 提高效率；提升效能
words.ex: He uses a new tool to improve efficiency.
words.ex_cn: 他使用一个新工具来提高效率。
words.en: To make something more efficient or to enhance the productivity of a process or system.

words.tr: phrase. 提高生产力；增加生产效率
words.ex: The new machine helps increase productivity.
words.ex_cn: 这台新机器有助于提高生产率。
words.en: To enhance the efficiency and output of work or production, often by improving methods, tools, or processes.

words.tr: phrase. 促进创新；鼓励新思想或新技术的发展
words.ex: The school helps to foster innovation in students.
words.ex_cn: 学校帮助培养学生的创新能力。
words.en: To encourage the creation of new ideas and methods.

words.tr: phrase. 航空业；航空公司行业
words.ex: The airline industry is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 航空公司行业正在快速发展。
words.en: The global industry involved in transporting passengers and cargo by aircraft, including airlines and related services.

words.tr: phrase. 技术进步；科技发展
words.ex: Technological advances have revolutionized the way we communicate.
words.ex_cn: 技术进步彻底改变了我们的沟通方式。
words.en: Progress in technology that makes it possible to do new things or to do old things in a new way.

words.tr: n. 可用的工具
words.ex: The available tool is simple to use.
words.ex_cn: 可用的工具很简单易用。
